note: *Deus, atendei em meu auxílio*, the line that opens every Hour: deferred to you (D40). The stylist says *atender em* is not Portuguese; *acudi* drops D3's verb. The second half, *apressai-vos para auxiliar-me*, waits with it (39:14, D41).

*Sejam envergonhados e desonrados* (= 34:4): both Latinist runs ask *confundidos* for *revereántur*. Held so the three shame words stay apart; *confundidos* is the word D15 took from *confúndi*. HANDOFF item 17 asks your ruling on *desonrar*.

*Que bom, que bom*: the Latinist, the stylist and the blind reader all miss the mockery; the Latinist is right on the merits. Held only for rule 6 (= 39:16); *Bem feito* is proposed for all four places.
*o meu auxílio* for *adjútor*, held against both Latinist runs (*auxiliador*) as at 39:18b. The adjútor row (D24) is open for you.
